How to add a widget

Install Söz or Hush in your Kare Library, then choose Add to Home Screen. Confirm placement and save the widget configuration. If your launcher does not support direct placement, long-press an empty area of your home screen, open Widgets and choose Kare. Other catalog designs do not have an Android home-screen widget yet.
